Board governance of human capital in the age of AI

Insights from 800+ leaders in 50+ countries on governing technology and human capital together

Technology is reshaping work, but boards often oversee workforce strategy and tech transformation separately. This report explores governance challenges and the leadership actions needed to oversee AI-driven transformation and human capital together.
